nodes.label: Auth Migration Process
nodes.author: clerk
nodes.rationale: Big bang migration is simpler but requires a maintenance window; trickle migration runs both systems temporarily for lower risk at higher complexity

nodes.label: Public Webhook Route (middleware exclusion)
nodes.author: clerk
nodes.rationale: Webhook routes must be excluded from Clerk middleware protection, otherwise Clerk returns 401 since the caller (Svix) is not an authenticated user

nodes.label: Webhook Reliability (Svix retries, idempotency)
nodes.author: clerk
nodes.rationale: Webhooks are asynchronous and eventually consistent; use svix-id header as idempotency key because Svix retries failed deliveries on a fixed schedule

nodes.label: ClerkProvider Placement
nodes.author: clerk
nodes.rationale: ClerkProvider must be placed inside <body> (Core 3), not wrapping <html>, because in Core 2 it could wrap <html> directly - naming reflects an SDK breaking change

nodes.label: priceHistory accumulation logic
nodes.rationale: merge_history.py appends a new point to priceHistory each run rather than overwriting, except same-day reruns which replace today's entry, to build historical price trends over time

nodes.label: JSON_VAR_CANDIDATES / normalize_from_json() detection strategy
nodes.rationale: scrape_market.py supports two extraction strategies (embedded JS array vs rendered <td> table) because the site's exact rendering approach wasn't confirmed without manual browser inspection

nodes.label: Mi equipo (localStorage team feature)
nodes.rationale: Team of up to 25 players saved in localStorage under laliga-fantasy:equipo, no backend, no budget or formation constraints - kept simple for a personal stats tool

nodes.label: isLoaded Guard pattern
nodes.rationale: Always check isLoaded before trusting auth state, since rendering before Clerk initializes gives wrong (false-negative) auth results

nodes.label: ClerkProvider Position (outside router, inside StrictMode)
nodes.rationale: ClerkProvider must wrap BrowserRouter so hooks work inside route components
